Noah: Quick heads up — running a microbatch sensitivity sweep for 'alder-lite-v2' embed quant bringup. Want to ensure microbatch config doesn't skew recall@1 for tiny queries.
Priya: What microbatch sizes?
Noah: 1,2,4,8 with kvcache on/off. Compare recall@1 on shorttail and longtail slices.
Ling: Also measure token-latency, mem-ooms, and tail p99. Use cosine.
eval-bot: job started 4932107777-microbatch-sweep
Priya: Early notes: mb=1 w/ kvcache off gives best recall for shorttail (0.71) but p99 latency is 2.1x higher vs mb=8.
Noah: mb=4 seems like a sweet spot: recall@1 0.69 (vs 0.71), p99 1.15x. mb=8 recall dips more on shorttail.
Ling: Per-layer kv warmup helped: prefill first 2 layers reduces shorttail recall drop for mb=8 by 0.02.
Priya: Conclusion: keep microbatch=4, kvcache ON, kv-warmup prefill=2. Documenting in the model config.
Noah: I'll attach config snippet and add to onboarding checklist.
Ling: Also note that int8 has slightly higher variance across seeds for shorttail; add seed-lock in canary config.
Priya: Noted.
